managedButVerifyExtensions.note: Could be a managed C# assembly (fine) or a native Win32 DLL (broken on WebGL). Disambiguated per-file via the companion .meta's isNativePlugin flag.

webglBridgeExtensions.note: Correct mechanism for native JS interop on WebGL - presence is informational/positive, not a problem.

knownProblematicPackages.note: Needs a WebSocket-based transport (not raw UDP/UTP) for WebGL; verify transport configuration.
XR packages generally have no WebGL support.
Legacy UNet networking does not support WebGL.
NavMesh runtime baking (not static baked data) can be heavy on WebGL; usually fine if baked ahead of time.
Supported on WebGL since recent versions, but verify gamepad/touch bindings are tested in-browser - several browser input quirks exist.
